title: MemoryAnswer
description: An answer from Argon (or Neon transcript-only fallback FB7) to a question about the conversation.

question.description: The user's memory question (e.g. 'What did she say about the schedule?').

answer.description: Grounded answer extracted from the conversation.

time.description: Timestamp or offset of the referenced moment (e.g. '00:02:14', ISO-8601 string, or seconds), or null if not found.

clip.description: Clip identifier or relative path under clips/ for the referenced moment (consenting speakers only), or null if unavailable.

source.description: Model path used ('neon-transcript-only' when FB7 is active).

latency_ms.description: Query latency in milliseconds (AT10 target: <= 8000 ms).

face_id.description: Attributed face ID for the referenced moment, if applicable.
